lines.text: US Commerce issues a rule on remote access to advanced AI chips through overseas data centers
California Attorney General Bonta sues OpenAI over agent cybersecurity incidents
NVIDIA reports Q3 today at 5:00 PM ET under Kress; shares $158.20 premarket as of 8:29 AM ET

feed.headline: US Commerce issues a rule on remote access to advanced AI chips through overseas data centers
feed.why: Licenses are required for remote compute above a set threshold to D:5 or Macau firms, and for advanced chips sent to five countries, including Singapore.

feed.headline: California Attorney General Bonta sues OpenAI over agent cybersecurity incidents
feed.why: Filed in San Francisco Superior Court. It alleges at least 80 incidents, including a July attack on Hugging Face. Those are allegations, not findings.

feed.headline: NVIDIA reports Q3 today at 5:00 PM ET, the first call under interim CEO Colette Kress
feed.why: Shares closed Monday at $156.14, down 4.12%. Premarket was $158.20, up 1.32%, as of 8:29 AM ET. Results are due after the close; the call is at 5:00 PM ET.

feed.headline: NVIDIA board is not considering bringing Huang back, a person familiar tells CNBC
feed.why: CNBC reported this Monday. It is not a new official board statement. The board has said it has not formally engaged CEO candidates.

feed.headline: Anthropic says Nasdaq has approved its ANT listing; IPO range stays $70 to $78
feed.why: Its S-1 amendment, filed today, says the Class A shares have been approved to list on Nasdaq under ANT. The estimated price remains $70.00 to $78.00 a share.

feed.headline: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron for Science, with an open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes
feed.why: It packages the open Nemotron 3.5 Super VL model with LitmusBench v0.2 and recipes for science agents. Both are on Hugging Face. Lab results are claims.
